answer: Sybil resistance comes from requiring each identity to complete a fresh VDF: a prescribed chain of modular squarings in which every result depends on the previous one. GPUs can run separate chains concurrently, but cannot eliminate the sequential bottleneck within any clone; creating many identities therefore multiplies the work and hardware required. A Wesolowski proof lets others verify completion efficiently. The labels dawn, onyx, and tide can distinguish epochs, not bypass the delay.
